headline: Does giving a camera wings dodge the FCC’s drone ban?
summary: HoverAir is attempting to bypass a US FCC drone ban with its latest drone. The company seeks to exploit a loophole in upcoming 2025 regulations. This move follows HoverAir's history of unique drone features.

headline: Nielsen is leaning more on wearables to hear what people are watching
summary: Nielsen will integrate data from wearable devices to enhance viewership measurement. This aims to improve accuracy in tracking streaming content consumption. The new data capture process will be implemented ahead of the upcoming fall season.

headline: Google Gemini is getting a dedicated student hub
summary: Google Gemini is launching a new dedicated student hub for the back-to-school season. This hub will offer tools for research, creating flashcards, and taking practice quizzes. It also features enhanced study notebooks with support for graphs and images.

headline: Watch Valve set up the Steam Frame in its own leaked videos
summary: Valve accidentally leaked unboxing and setup videos for its new Steam Frame VR headset. The videos briefly appeared on the ARM Steam client before being swiftly removed. The Steam Frame is Valve's virtual-reality headset designed for streaming games.

headline: The X-Tech Executive Chair Aims to Upend Premium Models from Herman Miller, Steelcase at a Better Price
summary: The X-Tech Executive Chair is entering the super premium office chair market. It aims to compete with high-end models from brands like Herman Miller and Steelcase. The chair promises a better price point compared to established premium models.

headline: Ryan Reynolds Congratulates Christopher Nolan's the Odyssey for Surpassing Deadpool & Wolverine to Become Highest Grossing R-Rated Movie of All Time
summary: Ryan Reynolds congratulated Christopher Nolan as 'The Odyssey' surpassed 'Deadpool & Wolverine'. Nolan's film became the highest-grossing R-rated movie of all time. Both movies have held this box office record at different points.

headline: Save $75 Off the Nintendo Switch 2 Plus Up to $130 in Best Buy Credit When You Trade in a Switch Console
summary: Best Buy is offering a deal for the Nintendo Switch 2, including $75 off the console. Customers can also receive up to $130 in trade-in credit for an old Switch. This deal provides up to $205 in total savings before a price increase on September 1.

headline: Mail-Order Media Giant Columbia House Shutting Down After 71 Years
summary: Columbia House, the mail-order music and movie club, is officially shutting down. After 71 years of operation, the company will cease new orders. The closure marks the end of an era for the media giant.

headline: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to UK
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan, the Duke and Duchess of Sussex, are reportedly moving back to the UK. Their children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, are enrolled in a British school. The children are expected to start classes in September.

headline: Harry and Meghan are experts in surprise - but is their UK return forever?
summary: Harry and Meghan's sudden decision to return to the UK has sparked many questions. The move raises speculation about the permanence of their relocation. It creates uncertainty for both the couple and the Royal Family.

headline: Vaccine breakthrough stops cancer returning in trial
summary: A new vaccine trial shows promising results in preventing cancer recurrence. The jab extended the length of time patients remained cancer-free. Further research is needed to determine the long-term effectiveness of the vaccine.

headline: People smuggler exposed by BBC investigation arrested and charged
summary: A people smuggler, Twana Jamal Khdir, exposed by a BBC investigation has been arrested. He has been charged with immigration offences. The arrest follows a detailed BBC exposé on his activities.
